title: KSA Coffer reference repositories
description: Inventory of the git repositories checked out under references/. Used to detect when reference material is out of date. Maintained by scripts/references_check_refs.ts.

repos.description: One entry per folder under references/.

name.description: Folder name of the checkout under references/. Unique within repos.

git.description: Git remote URI the checkout was cloned from (the 'origin' remote).

ref.description: Full commit hash (SHA-1, or SHA-256 for sha256 repositories) of the checkout's HEAD when it was last recorded.

license.description: License of the repository as an SPDX identifier or expression, e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-2.0, GPL-3.0.
